caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug positioned centrally on an off-white background. The jug has a rounded body with a short, slightly flared neck, a small spout, and a curved handle attached from the lip to the widest part of the body. The surface of the jug features a mottled, marbled pattern in shades of brown and orange. The base rim and the rim around the opening are highlighted with a slightly darker brown, and fine dotted lines encircle both the neck and the widest part of the jug. The handle and spout are integrated into the body with smooth transitions, and there are no visible decorations or objects around the jug. The background remains plain, with slight variations in shading, possibly indicating the texture of the paper.
title: Water Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
